INSERT INTO jc_watches (name, urls, criteria, every_minutes, channels)
SELECT j->>'name', j->'urls', j->>'criteria', (j->>'every_minutes')::int, j->'channels'
FROM (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j) p
RETURNING id, name, urls, criteria, every_minutes, channels, last_run, last_error;

SELECT id, name, urls, criteria, every_minutes, channels, to_char(last_run AT TIME ZONE '__JC_TZ__', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_run, last_error
FROM jc_watches WHERE active AND $1 = $1 ORDER BY id;
UPDATE jc_watches SET active = false WHERE id = $1 AND active RETURNING id, name;
